description: This file defines a React-like component named TripsProvider that manages trip data within a travel planning application. It handles state management, data loading, and CRUD operations for trip objects, interfacing with storage and data model modules.

methods.name: createNewTrip
methods.description: Creates a new trip with specified details, saves it to storage, and updates the component's trip list.

methods.name: removeTrip
methods.description: Removes a trip by its ID from storage and updates the trip list.

methods.name: getTrip
methods.description: Retrieves a specific trip object by ID from storage.

methods.name: updateTrip
methods.description: Updates a trip using an updater function, saves changes, and refreshes the trip list.
